memory_update.text: SAIL is a clean reference candidate for AI-era identity governance because it directly targets AI agents, non-human identities, and machine identities.
VRNS is a mid-cap underfollowed candidate for data and AI security; key verification is whether Atlas and AllTrue.ai create measurable ARR or upsell impact.
AVPT is a low-attention, mid-cap discovery candidate in SaaS data governance, resilience, and agentic AI governance, especially around Microsoft/Google cloud ecosystems.
FROG is an indirect AI infrastructure software candidate: AI coding agents and model deployment may increase need for artifact, model, package, and MCP governance.
The node’s strongest public-company mappings are identity governance, data security posture management, AI-agent governance, and secure software/AI supply-chain systems of record.

Layer 2 should verify financial materiality: ARR contribution, module attach rates, customer case studies, marketplace traction, and whether AI-specific products are paid SKUs rather than marketing overlays.
